
  // (type string)
  public class Type_string {
    var p_any : Vx_Core.Type_any!
    var p_stringn : String
    public init() {}
  }

  // v_string_constructor
  public static func v_string_constructor(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    Vx_Core.v_global_reserve()
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.Type_string()
    return output
  }

  // v_string_create
  public static func v_string_create(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_string_constructor()
    Vx_Core.v_string_initialize(
      output)
    return output
  }

  // v_string_initialize
  public static func v_string_initialize(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_string
  ) {
    value.p_any = Vx_Core.v_any_from_type_backref(
      Vx_Core.t_string,
      value)
    value.p_stringn = ""
  }

  // v_string_shutdown
  public static func v_string_shutdown(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_string
  ) {
    value.p_stringn = ""
    Vx_Core.v_any_shutdown(
      value.p_any)
    Vx_Core.v_global_release()
  }

  // v_string_startup
  public static func v_string_startup(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    var t_variable : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.t_string
    var e_variable : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.e_string
    Vx_Core.v_string_initialize(
      e_variable)
    Vx_Core.v_type_t_startup(
      t_variable,
      "vx/core",
      "string",
      Vx_Core.e_string,
      e_variable.p_any)
    t_variable.p_propertylist = Vx_Core.v_varlist_from_listvar(
      [
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "stringn",
          Vx_Core.t_stringn)
      ])
    var type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_generic_create()
    type_generic.p_code_funcn = Vx_Core.v_code_string
    type_generic.p_copy_funcn = Vx_Core.v_copy_string
    type_generic.p_new_funcn = Vx_Core.v_new_string
    t_variable.type_generic = type_generic
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = t_variable
    return output
  }

  // v_cast_string
  public static func v_cast_string(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_string
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // v_string_cast
  public static func v_string_cast(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.e_string
    if type_any.type_type === Vx_Core.t_string {
      output = unsafeBitCast(type_any.backref, to: Vx_Core.Type_string.self)
    }
    return output
  }

  // v_string_copy
  public static func v_string_copy(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_string,
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.e_string
    return output
  }

  // v_copy_string
  public static func v_copy_string(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any,
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_string_cast(
      type_any)
    let copy_value : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_string_copy(
      value,
      type_anylist)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = copy_value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // v_string_new
  public static func v_string_new(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_string_copy(
      Vx_Core.e_string,
      type_anylist)
    return output
  }

  // v_new_string
  public static func v_new_string(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_string_new(
      type_anylist)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // f_string
  public static func f_string(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_string_new(
      type_anylist)
    return output
  }

  public static let t_string : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_type_constructor()
  public static let e_string : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_string_constructor()

  // v_any_from_stringn
  public static func v_any_from_stringn(
    _ stringn : String
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_string_from_stringn(
      stringn)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.v_cast_string(
      value)
    return output
  }

  // v_string_from_stringn
  public static func v_string_from_stringn(
    _ stringn : String
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_string = v_string_create()
    output.p_stringn = stringn
    return output
  }

  // v_stringn_from_string
  public static func v_stringn_from_string(
    _ type_string : Vx_Core.Type_string
  ) -> String {
    return type_string.stringn
  }

  // v_listany_from_liststring
  public static func v_listany_from_liststring(
    _ liststring : [Vx_Core.Type_string]
  ) -> [Vx_Core.Type_any] {
    var output : [Vx_Core.Type_any] = []
    for value : Vx_Core.Type_string in liststring {
      output.append(value.type_any)
    }
    return output
  }

  // v_liststring_from_listany
  public static func v_liststring_from_listany(
    _ listany : [Vx_Core.Type_any]
  ) -> [Vx_Core.Type_string] {
    var output : [Vx_Core.Type_string] = []
    for type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any in listany {
      let value : Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_string_from_any(type_any)
      if value !== Vx_Core.e_string {
        output.append(value)
      }
    }
    return output
  }

  // v_string_copy
  public static func v_string_copy(
    _ copyval : Vx_Core.Type_string,
    _ anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_string {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_string = copyval
    Vx_Core.v_reserve_listany(
      [
        copyval.type_any,
        anylist.type_any
      ]
    )
    let filter_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist = Vx_Core.v_anylist_from_listtype_anylist(
      [Vx_Core.t_string],
      anylist
    )
    let msgblock : Vx_Core.Type_msgblock = Vx_Core.v_msgblock_from_any(
      filter_anylist.type_any
    )
    var ischanged : Bool = false
    let orig_msgblock : Vx_Core.Type_msgblock = Vx_Core.v_msgblock_from_any(
      copyval.type_any
    )
    if msgblock !== orig_msgblock {
      ischanged = true
    }
    var stringn : String = ""
    if filter_anylist !== Vx_Core.e_anylist {
      let stringlist : Vx_Core.Type_stringlist = Vx_Core.v_stringlist_from_anylist(filter_anylist)
      let liststringn : [String] = Vx_Core.v_liststringn_from_liststring(stringlist.liststring)
      Vx_Core.v_release(stringlist.type_any)
      stringn = v_stringn_from_liststringn_joinn(liststringn, "")
    }
    if !ischanged {
      ischanged = stringn == copyval.stringn
    }
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_string = copyval
    if ischanged {
      let type_delta : Vx_Core.Type_delta = Vx_Core.v_delta_from_any(
        filter_anylist.type_any
      )
      Vx_Core.v_reserve_msgblock(msgblock)
      Vx_Core.v_reserve_delta(type_delta)
      output = Vx_Core.Type_string = Vx_Core.v_string_create()
      output.stringn = stringn
      output.type_any.type_msgblock = msgblock
      output.type_any.type_delta = type_delta
    }
    Vx_Core.v_release_except_listany(
      output.type_any,
      [
        copyval.type_any,
        anylist.type_any,
        filter_anylist.type_any
      ]
    )
    return output
  }
